args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and this fallback is silently used to build the password reset link (and other links in this file). It looks like the production environment is missing PUBLIC_URL, so users receive reset emails pointing at localhost.

Proposed fix: make the missing-PUBLIC_URL case loud instead of silently defaulting to localhost — e.g. read BASE_URL from config (which should validate required env vars at startup) and throw/log an error if it's not set in non-development environments, keeping the localhost fallback only for local development. Also ensure the deployment configuration actually sets PUBLIC_URL for the production release so real links are generated.
